__doc__: Copy to paper_config.json (gitignored) and edit. Every key is optional;
paths.py documents the default for each. An environment variable
PAPER_<KEY> overrides both this file and the default.
This file is the place for machine-specific and identifying values, so
that neither appears in the committed scripts or a released artifact.
Defaults are chosen so a fresh clone runs without this file: in-repo
paths derive from the checkout, ~/.claude is where Claude Code keeps
transcripts on every platform, and traces_dir assumes the trace archive
is checked out beside this repo. Set a key here only to override one.
__identity__: Strings that appear INSIDE the corpus text, which the parsing and
scrubbing code must recognise to behave correctly. Defaults derive from
the running machine and the checkout directory name, which is what the
corpus actually contains, so these usually need no entry here.
Set them when the corpus was captured under a different home directory
or when the notes repo appears under more than one spelling.
__interpreter__: Override with the PYTHON_INTERPRETER env var; defaults to the running interpreter.
